dslRule:
<!id: io.exception.message.prefix.trees>
<!description: Prefixes a specific IOException message related to ambiguous ElementTree order with 'Unable to save workspace - ' for improved clarity and consistency with other workspace save errors.>
<!severity: INFO>

new java.io.IOException("Trees in ambiguous order (Bug 352867)")
=>
new java.io.IOException("Unable to save workspace - Trees in ambiguous order (Bug 352867)")
;;
summary: Prefixes a specific IOException message for consistency with other workspace saving errors.
